text:
Starling

 Local AI in .NET, with no Python sidecar and no API key. 

 
 
 
 
 

 

Starling packages open models as ordinary NuGet libraries: embeddings, entity extraction, image and video search, and chat. They run on ONNX Runtime on CPU or CUDA and plug into Microsoft.Extensions.AI ( IEmbeddingGenerator , IChatClient ), so code you wrote against a hosted provider can move to a local model by changing one line at the call site (moving from a hosted provider walks through the whole move). Embeddings still need re-indexing, and a small local model is not a large hosted one. Each model is pinned to an exact upstream commit, verified by SHA-256, and checked against the original PyTorch/Python implementation before it is released.

 Try it in your browser : multilingual search with nothing to install. It downloads a 182 MB model once, and what you type stays on the page.

⭐ If this is useful, star the repository so other .NET developers can find it.

 Using an AI coding agent? Point it at llms.txt or install the Starling skill.

 What you can build

Three complete programs in ai-dotnet/samples/ . Each downloads its models once, then runs with the network off. The output below is from a run on Linux x64 CPU with no network interface, on the published 0.5.0 packages.

 Ask a folder of docs

 LocalRag answers from your own Markdown and text files, using EmbeddingGemma 2 and Qwen3.5 through Microsoft.Extensions.AI .

 

 

It's a small-folder demonstration: it re-embeds every paragraph on each question, and a 0.8B model can be wrong, so it prints its sources.

 Triage tickets in any language

 TicketTriage trains a router on English tickets in an ordinary ML.NET pipeline, then routes German, Spanish, French and Japanese tickets with the same model. GLiNER2 pulls out the entities.

 

 

 Search photos with text

 EmbeddingGemma2Search puts text and images in one embedding space, so a text query can rank a folder of photos.

 

 

Vision takes about 4.5 s per photo on a 12-thread CPU, so start with a small folder or use CUDA.

The first run downloads the model (about 487 MB) into your user cache; later runs work offline. The application chooses the ONNX Runtime native package: Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime for CPU, or Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.Linux for CUDA on Linux x64. If this or a later step fails, troubleshooting collects the errors people hit on first runs, with the fix for each.

 Local chat through IChatClient 

 

 

Ten complete programs are in ai-dotnet/samples/ : semantic search with e5 ( E5Search ), with an in-memory Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData collection ( E5VectorStore ) and with a reranking second stage ( E5RerankSearch , Experimental), text, image and video search with EmbeddingGemma 2 ( EmbeddingGemma2Search ), entity extraction with GLiNER2 ( Gliner2Ner ), streaming chat with Qwen3.5 ( QwenChat ), local question answering over your own files ( LocalRag ), multilingual ticket triage in an ML.NET pipeline ( TicketTriage ), and e5 search in the browser from Blazor WebAssembly ( E5BrowserSearch ) and from a JavaScript page ( E5BrowserJs ), both on the Experimental browser packages.

 Models

Choosing a text embedder? See choosing an embedding model.

 Model What it does Package CPU CUDA 
 --- --- --- --- --- 
 multilingual-e5-small Text embeddings, 100 languages Starlings.Models.E5 (+ .Extensions.AI , .MLNet ) Stable Stable 
 EmbeddingGemma 2 Text, image and video embeddings in one space Starlings.Models.EmbeddingGemma2 (+ .Extensions.AI , .MLNet , .Imaging.SkiaSharp , .Video.FFmpeg , .Video.FFmpeg9 ) Stable (text, image, video) Stable (text, image, video) 
 GLiNER2 Zero-shot entity extraction with any labels Starlings.Models.Gliner2 Stable Stable 
 Qwen3.5-0.8B Chat and text generation Starlings.Models.Qwen35.OnnxGenAI (+ .Extensions.AI ; model definition Starlings.Models.Qwen35 ) Stable Stable (fp32x and fp16x) 

 Experimental, on nuget.org from 0.3.0: Starlings.Models.Kev (Kev-0.8B and Kev-4B decision models, CPU and CUDA) and Starlings.Models.QwenChat (Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct text chat, CPU) have no Stable profile; their model files download from public hosting (release record). Starlings.Models.Bert is on nuget.org from 0.4.0 with Experimental profiles only. Starlings.Models.Whisper builds and tests on main but is not published; build it from this repository.

 Model What it does Project Status 
 --- --- --- --- 
 Kev-0.8B, Kev-4B Decision models: a calibrated probability per option, no generated text Starlings.Models.Kev.Onnx (model definition Starlings.Models.Kev ) Experimental, CPU and CUDA fp32; four registry profiles ( kev-0.8b , kev-4b : onnx-fp32-cpu , onnx-fp32-cuda ) 
 all-MiniLM-L6-v2, bge-small-en-v1.5, bge-base-en-v1.5, nomic-embed-text-v1.5, paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2, gte-reranker-modernbert-base BERT text embeddings and reranking Starlings.Models.Bert Experimental, CPU fp32; proposed evidence only. paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 and gte-reranker-modernbert-base are not in the 0.5.0 package 
 Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Text-only chat Starlings.Models.QwenChat.OnnxGenAI (model definition Starlings.Models.QwenChat ) Experimental, CPU fp32; proposed evidence only 
 whisper-large-v3-turbo Speech-to-text: 30 s of 16 kHz audio to an English transcript (greedy) Starlings.Models.Whisper Experimental, CPU fp16 graphs, source only; one registry profile ( whisper-large-v3-turbo/onnx-fp16-cpu ), no release gate run 

Their candidate contracts are in model-pipeline/candidates/ and the BERT and Qwen chat onboarding workflow is in model-pipeline/FIVE MODELS.md . The QwenChat sample uses the published Qwen3.5 packages, not Starlings.Models.QwenChat .

 Stable means every release gate passed: provenance, numerical parity and task quality against the Python reference, a one-hour leak soak, bench

install.title: Quickstart
install.html:
Requires the .NET 10 SDK. Multilingual semantic search in four commands:

dotnet new console -o search && cd search
dotnet add package Starlings.Models.E5.Extensions.AI
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime --version 1.30.0

Replace Program.cs with:

using System.Numerics.Tensors;
using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Starlings.Models.E5;
using Starlings.Models.E5.Extensions.AI;

// One-time download, pinned by commit and checked by SHA-256. Inference never touches the network.
E5ModelFiles files = await E5ModelAssets.DownloadAsync();
using var embedder = E5EmbeddingGenerator.Create(files);

// e5 expects "passage: " on documents and "query: " on queries.
string[] docs = ["passage: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.",
                 "passage: Der Rhein fließt durch Köln.",
                 "passage: 富士山は日本一高い山です。"];
var docVectors = await embedder.GenerateAsync(docs);
var query = await embedder.GenerateVectorAsync("query: Which river runs through Cologne?");

foreach (var (doc, v) in docs.Zip(docVectors))
    Console.WriteLine($"{TensorPrimitives.CosineSimilarity(query.Span, v.Vector.Span):F3}  {doc}");

dotnet run

0.680  passage: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
0.807  passage: Der Rhein fließt durch Köln.
0.688  passage: 富士山は日本一高い山です。

The first run downloads the model (about 487 MB) into your user cache; later runs work offline. The application chooses the ONNX Runtime native package: Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime for CPU, or Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.Linux for CUDA on Linux x64. If this or a later step fails, troubleshooting collects the errors people hit on first runs, with the fix for each.

Local chat through IChatClient
dotnet add package Starlings.Models.Qwen35.Extensions.AI
dotnet add package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntimeGenAI --version 0.17.1

using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using Starlings.Models.Qwen35;
using Starlings.Models.Qwen35.Extensions.AI;

Qwen35ModelFiles files = await Qwen35ModelAssets.DownloadAsync(Qwen35Variant.Fp32x); // about 3 GB, once
using IChatClient chat = Qwen35ChatClient.Create(files);

await foreach (var update in chat.GetStreamingResponseAsync("In one sentence, why is the sky blue?"))
    Console.Write(update.Text);

Ten complete programs are in ai-dotnet/samples/: semantic search with e5 (E5Search), with an in-memory Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData collection (E5VectorStore) and with a reranking second stage (E5RerankSearch, Experimental), text, image and video search with EmbeddingGemma 2 (EmbeddingGemma2Search), entity extraction with GLiNER2 (Gliner2Ner), streaming chat with Qwen3.5 (QwenChat), local question answering over your own files (LocalRag), multilingual ticket triage in an ML.NET pipeline (TicketTriage), and e5 search in the browser from Blazor WebAssembly (E5BrowserSearch) and from a JavaScript page (E5BrowserJs), both on the Experimental browser packages.
